sentences.text: He has  stated in his FIR that, on 25/03/2019, on prior information, the  first informant and others searched a vehicle brought at the  premises of Gajanan Transport at Village Budhgaon, Taluka  Miraj, District Sangli.
On their inspection they found that the  truck contained various prohibited articles i.e. Pan Masala worth  Rs.5,14,080/- and Tobacco worth Rs.1,52,600/-.
The articles  were seized.
The FIR was lodged.
Investigation revealed that the  container was driven by one Nawab Shaukatali Taumar.
It was  dispatched by one Subhash Sharma, who was the owner of  Mahalaxi Transport, Delhi and it was to be unloaded at Gajanan  Transport at Sangli.
After that the goods were to be given to the  present Applicant.
Based on this FIR, the present Applicant is  arrested on 26/03/2019.
3. The FIR is lodged on 25/03/2019 and the Applicant is  arrested on 26/03/2019.
The Applicant is already in judicial  custody.
For more than two months he is in custody.

sentences.text: The activities of the Applicant can be  controlled by imposing suitable conditions.
4. In these circumstances, I am inclined to grant bail to  the Applicant on certain conditions.

Hence, the following order :
 ORDER (i) The Applicant is directed to be released on bail in connection with C.R. No.74/09 registered with Sangli Rural Police Station, on his furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one or two sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall attend Sangli Rural Police Station every Sunday between 03.00 to 05.00 p.m. for a period of six months.
(iii) The Applicant shall not indulge in any other similar or other crime.
 4/4 56-BA-1292-19.od  (iv) If the Applicant is involved in any crime, that fact shall entitle the State of Maharashtra to apply for cancellation of bail.
(v) Application stands disposed of accordingly.

(SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
